blurb: Island Queen Cruises & Tours operates sightseeing and party cruises from Bayside Marketplace in Miami, showcasing Miami's skyline, Millionaire's Row, and other attractions. They also offer bus tours, Everglades experiences, ferry trips to Bimini, and private yacht charters. Their fleet includes several yachts with air conditioning and bars, and they provide bilingual tours and various ticket options.
